case.title: Security Test Coverage Claim
case.spec_ref: Security tests for unauthorised access, prompt injection, SSRF/path traversal, payload abuse, and secret leakage.

claim.statement: The system performs security tests that cover unauthorized access, prompt injection, SSRF/path traversal, payload abuse, and secret leakage.

evidence.title: Unauthorized Access Test Result
evidence.description: Test executed a series of forged authentication tokens and was unable to gain elevated privileges. No unauthorized access was observed.

evidence.title: Prompt Injection Test Result
evidence.description: Sent crafted prompts containing hidden commands; the system correctly sanitized inputs and did not execute any unintended code.

evidence.title: SSRF/Path Traversal Test Result
evidence.description: Attempted to fetch internal URLs and access local file paths via allowed inputs; responses returned error codes without exposing internal resources.

evidence.title: Payload Abuse Test Result
evidence.description: Injected oversized and malformed payloads; system flagged and rejected all payloads, maintaining stability.

evidence.title: Secret Leakage Test Result
evidence.description: Searched logs and responses for leak of API keys and tokens; no secrets were exposed in the outputs.

provenance.spec_ref: Security tests for unauthorised access, prompt injection, SSRF/path traversal, payload abuse, and secret leakage.
